tasks.title: task progress command
tasks.description: a new `task progress` command should be created that displays a live updating progress bar. on launch, it should calculate the number of uncompleted tasks. then it should display a progress bar with the text '(0/n)' where n is the total number of uncompleted tasks. aevery 5 seconds, the number of uncompleted tasks should be re-checked, and if a task was completed, the progress bar should increase in value. the command should exit once all tasks are complete.

tasks.title: Phase 1: Create ProgressMonitor.swift

tasks.title: Phase 3: Integrate into main.swift
tasks.description: Add handleProgress() function to the main switch. Call monitorProgressWithStore(store) in the progress case. Add appropriate error handling and exit codes. Ensure proper integration with existing code structure.

tasks.title: Phase 4: Test the Progress Command
tasks.description: Create a temporary test directory with tasks.json. Add 10-15 tasks to test directory. Run task progress in test directory. Verify progress bar updates every 5 seconds. Verify exit when all tasks complete. Verify graceful Ctrl+C handling.
